content.text: Events related to Court Gurus .
Requires or .
Court Gurus are recruited by the Search for a Guru Decision decision .
The decision will create one of 3 possible (15% chance of Great, 80% ordinary or 5% fake) Court Gurus will the following characteristics:
Real Gurus will be 50 years old, fake ones 40. A Great Guru will be genius whereas an ordinary one will be quick .
All Guru types will have the Loyal ( +100 Opinion) modifier for 100 years.
This event offers a 10% possiblity to remove a trait at the cost of 20 Prestige. Refusing cost 20 Piety and a Disapointed ( -5 Opinion) modifier for the Guru for 1 year.
Trageted traits: drunkard , hedonist , lustful , gluttonous , greedy , envious , arbitrary , cynical , cruel , paranoid
For Jain characters, this event also targets duelist , hunter and falconer .

The impaler , wroth and proud traits add the additional option of imprisoning the Guru at the cost of 50 Piety. This will give the Guru the Unhappy ( -20 Opinion) modifier indefinitely as well as Sacrilege ( -10 Opinion) for other realm characters for 2 years.
Cannot trigger for dull , slow , imbecile , inbred or trusting rulers. Has a mtth of 6 months.
The Guru becomes drunkard , loses -50 Piety and is suspected of being a fake Guru. Next event in 15 days if the ruler presses the issue further.

The Guru then loses 100 Piety, gain arbitrary , deceitful , cynical , the Whoremaster ( -1 to all Attributes) and Gambler ( -1 to Martial, -3 to Stewardship and Intrigue) character modifiers. The ruler can choose either to become friends with Guru or removing them.
The Guru is then removed either by imprisonement or banishment.
If the player character is zealous , ambitious or genius , it has a 75% of success, otherwise 25% chance. Cannot trigger with a fake Guru.
If failed, there is a 5% chance of becoming slothful , and losing 10 Prestige and Piety.
Only for Buddhist characters. Cannot trigger with a fake Guru.
50% chance of removing stressed and/or depressed , 100% if Genius .
